before.scope: Same current binary and deterministic2P4x/SS2 fixed-alpha1 sequence, nearest filtering, visible-sample path versus full raster; all captured presented frames compared. Contacts excluded; no timing claim.

after.scope: Same current binary and deterministic2P4x/SS2 fixed-alpha1 sequence, nearest filtering, visible-sample path versus full raster; all captured presented frames compared. Contacts excluded; no timing claim.

state_overlay.scope: Private rewind-enabled profile without scripted input replacing the virtual pad; actual shipped save/load path and HD sampled after restore; rewind browser opened/cancelled through virtual controller. Does not qualify committed rewind or fix the pre-existing22-cycle resimulation issue.

shader_fix_ab.scope: Matched same-server2P4xSS2 fixed2worker visible presenter, A/B/B/A whole scenario unpaced throughput; no GPU readback instrumentation. Presented captures identical; background load variation retained, no sustained-cadence claim.

full_raster_followup.scope: One later noninterleaved same-host/settings run, not a statistically qualified performance win. Retain actual interval percentiles/stalls and target costs.

decision: Retain exact integer nearest resolve and visible-sample optimization. Same-picture4x/SS2 throughput is neutral within baseline variation; later full-raster run is descriptive, not a proven speedup. Stalls and sustained pacing remain HD-10.
